purpose: Pin the MuMu JCC recognition evidence that is safe to reuse in the companion/runtime pipeline.

catalog_overlay_policy.source: the exact immutable Runtime Catalog compiled by and referenced from the active Core Profile
uses: current-season augment names and icon URLs
catalog_overlay_policy.hard_data_role: mechanics, formulas, damage/role/trait logic, and strategy indexes remain project hard-data sources
catalog_overlay_policy.big_data_role: daily Zhangmeng/ranking data remains the strategy strength/rate source
catalog_overlay_policy.excluded_reason: MuMu lineup/recommendation data is a third-party strategy recommendation/cache; it may be kept as format evidence only and must not contaminate project hard-data or daily big-data strategy signals.

desktop_mumu_runtime_bridge.primary_source: adb logcat from MuMu gameassist gi_plugin_jkchess / nemuinit

phase_status_enum.2: current_view_active; observed on opponent board during prep and on both boards during combat, so it is not a combat-only code

desktop_mumu_runtime_bridge.board_bench_rule: Within a fresh match_session_id, promote own board/bench only under the strong self-view anchor: S=1 plus a fresh visible non-empty 4354 shop. Then bench_units = 4352 wl and board_units_candidate = fresh 4353 hl minus 4352 overlap. S=2 means observing/non-self current view and must not be bound to battle_state; it must not update own board/bench/equipped items and must never create opponent board unit facts. 4353 is treated as an own-unit candidate source only, never an opponent unit source.
desktop_mumu_runtime_bridge.shop_rule: 4354 bl is the structured shop list and should be debounced for empty-list flicker. Non-empty 4354 is the strong own actionable view anchor; empty 4354 is transition/observing evidence only.
desktop_mumu_runtime_bridge.augment_rule: No separate structured augment-id GI payload has been observed; use s=4 only as the visual attention trigger, then run the host CLI multimodal current-frame visual pipeline against the visible choice panel. Emulator helper text logs are ignored by product live_state/advice.
desktop_mumu_runtime_bridge.equipment_rule: 4357 is the primary left item rail / inventory equipment source. 4356 is current-screen visible equipment rectangles; assign 4356 to own equipped_items only by coordinate match to trusted own 4353 units under the S=1 plus fresh non-empty 4354 shop anchor. Under S=2 or without the self-view anchor, keep 4356 as unassigned diagnostics only. Icon matching is fallback/conflict-check evidence, not the primary structured source.

capture_model.runtime_boundary: MuMu uses privileged display capture. Our companion uses MediaProjection for the same no-persist in-memory frame source.

ocr_engine.abi_scope: Product APK must not depend on MuMu x86_64 libRapidOcr. Multi-ABI OCR uses the product engine until a self-built NCNN/RapidOCR library is added.

mumu_roi_rules.name: augment_trigger_text
mumu_roi_rules.parser: OCR contains强化符文; detected box expands by width/5 and height/3

mumu_roi_rules.name: augment_choices
mumu_roi_rules.parser: OCR text is matched against SeasonConfig hex names

season_config_dictionary.policy: Production recognition resolves only against the Match-pinned active-season catalog. Historical MuMu decrypted configs are archive evidence and never a Runtime fallback.

companion_runtime_policy.product_native_dependency: No MuMu private native OCR library is bundled in the default APK.
companion_runtime_policy.match_scope: every new game must use a fresh match_session_id
companion_runtime_policy.promotion_guard: Visual candidates may promote only through summarizer policies with freshness, local-player binding, temporal stability, and identity confidence checks
